name: Tiger Mask
description: A villainous masked wrestler becomes a hero for the sake of protecting the orphanage in which he was raised.

videos.title: The Yellow Devil
videos.overview: A mysterious and feared masked wrestler named Tiger Mask, who has already made headlines throughout the Americas for his notorious dishonesty, returns to Japan. Regarded with disfavor by the entire Japan Pro-Wrestling Association, he is immediately ostracized; the only one who seems to understand him, despite everything, is Giant Baba, a respected and extremely honest pro-wrestler. Kenta, a boy living in the Chibikko House orphanage, despite everything and everyone, shows—uniquely among the children—a tremendous admiration for Tiger Mask. The two young people who currently run this shelter for abandoned children are also former orphans, a brother and sister: Kenta reminds him strongly of their old friend Naoto Date at his age, who ran away over ten years earlier and never returned, when after a visit to the zoo, standing in front of the tiger's cage, he resolutely declared that he too wanted to one day become as strong as a tiger...

videos.title: Tiger the Stormbringer
videos.overview: Little Kenta runs away from the orphanage to attend a match with Tiger Man, who is as ruthless as ever with his opponents.

videos.title: The Man Who Returned
videos.overview: Naoto returns to the orphanage where he grew up. While in the role of the Tiger Mask, he must face Monster, the man with the steel head.

videos.title: Law of Tiger's Cave
videos.overview: Uomo Tigre reflects on his training at the Tiger's Den, which subjected him to cruel and nearly unbearable training.

videos.title: Tiger Is Ready to Die
videos.overview: Mister X threatens Tigre d'Acciaio because he wants him to give him half of the money he earns from the matches at the Tiger Cage.

videos.title: Terrible Death Match
videos.overview: At the airport, a tiger escapes, but Pitone Nero, the next opponent of the Tiger Mask, stops her by rendering her docile with his charisma.

videos.title: The Bloodstained Tiger
videos.overview: After Ruriko asks Tiger Mask to fight fairly, he wins his first match without using illegal moves.

videos.title: Trap of Tiger's Cave
videos.overview: Ruriko begins to suspect that the Tiger Mask is actually Naoto, who, in the meantime, must evade the attacks of Mister X.

videos.title: The Starved Gorilla Man
videos.overview: The gigantic Gorilla Man arrives in Japan, the next opponent of Tiger Mask sent by the Tiger Cage.

videos.title: Fresh-Bomb Megaton Drop
videos.overview: Uomo Tigre is training for his next match, but Baba makes it clear that his method is wrong.

videos.title: The Marvelous World League
videos.overview: Baba tries to convince Tiger Mask to participate in the next World Tournament, but he is hesitant.

videos.title: For Whom He Fights?
videos.overview: Uomo Tigre fears that he will not be able to contain his unorthodox style for the World Tournament, but he will soon change his mind.

videos.title: The Terrible Hell Operation
videos.overview: During the meeting with Stella di Teschio, Mister X causes a blackout in the arena to carry out another one of his evil plans.

videos.title: Secret Training in Tiger's Cave
videos.overview: Daimon, Naoto's training partner, sends a letter to his friend from the Tiger's Den. However, Mister X gets ahold of it and uses it to blackmail him.

videos.title: Victory with Countless Wounds
videos.overview: Caught up in the excitement of cheering, Kenta breaks the orphanage's television, leaving the children unable to watch the next Tiger Mask match.

videos.title: Defeated Tiger
videos.overview: Stella di Teschio refuses to kill Naoto and is killed by Tana delle Tigre instead. L'Uomo Ombra doesn't want the same thing to happen to him.

videos.title: Tiger Awaked
videos.overview: Cappy is hit by a hit-and-run driver. Naoto and Kenta set out to find her.

videos.title: The Fate Showdown
videos.overview: Mister X tries to force Daimon to fight Naoto, even using torture. In the end, the man gives in and decides to face his friend in the ring.

videos.title: Two Hours Till the Starting Bout
videos.overview: L'Uomo Tigre decides to help a boy he just met. Will he make it back in time for his match?

videos.title: Shadow of Tiger's Cave
videos.overview: Naoto takes the orphans to the amusement park, but he is pursued by Tana delle Tigri there as well.

videos.title: The Red Fang with Revenge
videos.overview: Brisco had been confined to a wheelchair by Tiger Man when he was still evil. Now his brother has arrived in Japan to seek revenge.

videos.title: Challenge for Tomorrow
videos.overview: Tiger Man suffers an injury during a match and should rest, but his next match is too close.

videos.title: Tiger Risks His Life
videos.overview: Tana delle Tigri selects a group of masked wrestlers to send against Tiger Man.

videos.title: The Opening of the Maskmen League
videos.overview: Tigre decides to participate in the masked wrestlers' tournament to help the blind orphan girl. His first opponent is Mister No.

videos.title: Deadly Battle with the Golden Mask
videos.overview: Tiger Man must face two other masked wrestlers in the tournament in quick succession. The two use completely illegal tricks.

videos.title: Beyond the Glory
videos.overview: A mysterious new masked wrestler joins the tournament and teams up with Tiger Man against Lion Man and the Egyptian Mummy.

videos.title: Open Your Eyes, Tiger
videos.overview: With the money from the tournament, Tiger Man can finally get little Lory operated on, in the hope that she will regain her sight.

videos.title: Tiger's Cave Revives
videos.overview: Tana delle Tigri decides to build a new, larger, and more modern headquarters, while Mister X travels the world in search of new talent.

videos.title: Challenger Strong
videos.overview: Joe Fortis arrives in Japan to challenge Tiger Man. The new wrestler turns out to be a former coach of Naoto and Daimon.

videos.title: The Eternal Burning Spirit: Rikidozan Story
videos.overview: Naoto is very tense because he still can't come up with a winning move. Master Arashi tells him the story of a great champion from the past.

videos.title: So Special Training at Daisetsuzan
videos.overview: The Apollon brothers arrive in Japan. The younger brother is determined to challenge Tiger Man, who is training in the mountains to find his winning move.

videos.title: His Special Attack Is Born!
videos.overview: Tiger Man faces Ursus, the youngest of the Apollon brothers. During the match, he decides to use his new winning move.

videos.title: The Marvelous Battle
videos.overview: Tiger Man prepares for his match against Star, but he is quite worried. The day of the match arrives, and the two fight a great battle.

videos.title: A Hot-Blooded Boy in Tiger's Cave
videos.overview: The new talents at the Tiger's Den begin training that seems very different from what Naoto did in his day.

videos.title: Road to the Champion: Giant Baba Story
videos.overview: Tigre fears returning to his former self as an unfair fighter, so Baba decides to tell him his story and all the difficulties he had to face.

videos.title: The Opening of All Asia Championship
videos.overview: Tiger Man leaves for the Asian tournament and gradually gets to know all the wrestlers who will be participating.

videos.title: The Yeti of Himalaya
videos.overview: Tiger Man's first opponent is a giant Indian wrestler who hides a disturbing secret.

videos.title: Tiger Who Aims at the Champion
videos.overview: The Asian tournament is in full swing and every fighter is giving it their all. Tiger Man identifies Mister Ki as his most formidable opponent.

videos.title: Victory Crown with Tears
videos.overview: Mister Ki has found the winning counterattack to the "tiger's fall," and Tiger Man must find a solution quickly if he wants to win the final.

videos.title: Triumphant Return of Tiger the Phoenix
videos.overview: Tiger Man returns triumphant to Japan, but he knows he will never be able to use his "tiger drop" again.

videos.title: The Red Death Mask
videos.overview: The "Tiger Drop" is no longer effective, and Diavolo manages to defeat Naoto. At the end of the match, a new formidable wrestler from Tiger's Den arrives.

videos.title: No Tomorrow for Tiger
videos.overview: Death Mask seems like a truly unbeatable fighter, and everyone is very concerned about Tiger Man's fate.

videos.title: The Strongest Heel on the Earth
videos.overview: Death Mask proves himself to be a violent and ruthless fighter. Tiger will have to abandon his fair fighting style once again if he wants to win the match.

videos.title: The Challenge from Kamikaze
videos.overview: Naoto returns to the United States to fight in matches, but he is deeply troubled by what he did during his match against Death Mask.

videos.title: A Boy with Nostalgia to Home Country
videos.overview: Tigre arrives in Germany to face the giant Mapman. Meanwhile, the wrestler decides to have a new mask made to replace his worn-out one.

videos.title: The Secret Mission of Tiger's Cave
videos.overview: A young French wrestler leaves the Tiger's Den to find his father. Naoto decides to help him to prevent the boy from returning to that frightening place.

videos.title: Verbal Warfare in the Ring
videos.overview: Tiger Man must face Jungle King, a fierce fighter with mysterious powers. Tiger is warned by a previous opponent of the black fighter.

videos.title: The Battle with Kamikaze
videos.overview: The time has finally come for Tiger Man to face Kamikaze. Naoto has learned from previous encounters and is training to develop a new winning move.

videos.title: Tiger Mask Revives
videos.overview: Naoto returns to Japan after his European successes. His compatriots are eager to see his new final move.

videos.title: Give Your Affection to the Children
videos.overview: Tigre and other wrestlers are in Hiroshima for a series of matches. Naoto is fascinated by a model and wants to get his hands on it at all costs.

videos.title: An Eagle and a Tiger
videos.overview: Japanese wrestlers are determined to defend their colors, but foreign wrestlers use every kind of foul play to take home the victory.

videos.title: Win the the World League!
videos.overview: Mister X has something in mind regarding the tournament final between Tiger Man and Bill Hercules. What could his evil plan be?

videos.title: Mystery of the Miracles
videos.overview: Ken continues to train at the Tiger's Den, more determined than ever to defeat Tiger Man, whom he believes is responsible for his mother's death.

videos.title: A New Friend
videos.overview: A new girl arrives at Ruriko's orphanage. Little Micro seems rather spoiled and is unable to fit in with her new friends.

videos.title: The Sun in Soot and Smoke
videos.overview: Tiger Man and other wrestlers arrive in a city submerged by pollution. An orphan protests against a company to protect the health of his friend.

videos.title: The Black Deity
videos.overview: Popo Africa suffered a crushing defeat at the hands of Tiger Man when the latter was fighting as the Yellow Demon. Now he's back and swears revenge.

videos.title: His V-Sign Calls Death In
videos.overview: Nero V arrives in Japan determined to avenge his master Popo Africa. The fighter is very confident and immediately shows everyone his secret technique.

videos.title: Black V
videos.overview: The eagerly awaited match between Tiger Man and Nero V is about to begin, but first Baba and Inoki must face the Miracle Brothers.

videos.title: A Reckless Challenge
videos.overview: Tigre arrives at the dojo of one of his instructors and a friend of Master Arashi. Here he meets a young man determined to fight him in order to pay off his accumulated debts.

videos.title: Tiger and a Awkward Doctor
videos.overview: Tiger Man meets a doctor on a train who is addicted to alcohol. The doctor wants to treat a boy who has been in an accident, and Naoto offers his help.

videos.title: Road of "Shogi" King
videos.overview: Rudy, a new wrestler from Tiger's Den, says he is confident he can stop Tiger Man's winning move. Meanwhile, the wrestler prevents a sculptor from committing suicide.

videos.title: The Black Challenger
videos.overview: Tiger Man reads in a newspaper that a wrestler has died in the ring at the hands of the mysterious Black Panther. Naoto fears that he may be his next opponent.

videos.title: "Meriken" Joe
videos.overview: Tiger Man faces Demon, but thoughts of his upcoming opponents distract him considerably. However, an old man in the audience manages to spur him on.

videos.title: Till When the Fortunate Bell Rings
videos.overview: Naoto meets a young boy who is sitting alone looking sad, even though it's Christmas. The wrestler decides to follow him to find out what his problems are.

videos.title: Deadly Battle on the Maskmen Championship
videos.overview: Naoto meets Daimon at Master Arashi's dojo, and the two train together in preparation for Tiger's match against Black Panther.

videos.title: The Terror of Tiger's Cave
videos.overview: Naoto looks after Kenta, who is confined to bed with a fever. The child shows him an album of photographs of Tiger Man, and Naoto relives his career through those photos.

videos.title: Resurrection of the Yellow Devil
videos.overview: A new wrestler has recently appeared in America who calls himself the Yellow Devil, which is the old pseudonym of Tiger Man. Naoto is impressed.

videos.title: Phantom of the Yellow Devil
videos.overview: Tiger Man investigates the identity of the Yellow Devil and begins to strongly suspect that it is Ken. If it really is him, it would be very difficult for Naoto to fight him.

videos.title: The Rule-Brake Challenger
videos.overview: The young Junker from Tiger's Den challenges Tiger Man, disregarding the wishes of his organization. Meanwhile, the boy meets a child who is friends with Naoto.

videos.title: Regret at the Ring
videos.overview: Tiger Man and Kamikaze face off once again. However, Naoto cannot come to terms with Hans' death and swears revenge against Tana delle Tigri.

videos.title: Tiger Meets the Crisis!
videos.overview: Re Giaguaro, rising star of the American West, is chosen as Tiger Man's next challenger. This opponent also comes from Tiger's Den.

videos.title: Mr. Fudo Comes Onstage
videos.overview: Daimon finally returns to the ring wearing Mr. Fudo's mask. His strong performance wins over the hearts of fans.

videos.title: The Trump of Tiger's Cave
videos.overview: Yellow Devil finally manages to convince the Tiger's Den to let him meet Tiger Man. Ken is increasingly determined to avenge his mother.

videos.title: The Traitor No.3
videos.overview: Ken is kidnapped by Mr. X and Tana delle Tigri's hitmen. Daimon sets off in pursuit to save the boy's life.

videos.title: Great Escape from Tiger's Cave
videos.overview: Ken begins wrestling without a mask for the Japanese federation and enjoys great success. Some young people from Tana delle Tigri would like to follow his example.

videos.title: The Phantom Wrestlers
videos.overview: Black Tiger and Big Tiger challenge Tiger Man and Daimon. Naoto seems quite intimidated and does not want to tell his friend the news.

videos.title: Tag Team in the Deadly Battle
videos.overview: The day of the match against Big Tiger and Black Tiger has finally arrived. The fight is particularly violent, and all the wrestlers seem determined to fight to the death.

videos.title: Tiger Against Tiger
videos.overview: Daimon is in critical condition, and Naoto and Ken are very worried. As if that weren't enough, Naoto also has to face the Tiger King.

videos.title: The Big Boss of Tiger's Cave
videos.overview: The leader of Tiger's Den is very upset after the defeat of his best fighters, so he orders Mister X to assassinate Tiger Man.

videos.title: A Nova Is Born
videos.overview: Ken is improving visibly, but he still can't eliminate certain incorrect moves from his repertoire. Baba decides to put his trust in him anyway.

videos.title: The Promotor in Hell
videos.overview: Ken's popularity continues to grow. In his next match, he faces Black Hurricane, a very experienced and formidable wrestler.

videos.title: The Deadly Battle in Cage
videos.overview: Mister X has chosen Maschera Universo as Tiger Man's next challenger. The wrestler has remarkable athletic skills, which he shows off in front of journalists and Ken.

videos.title: When Does Happiness Come?
videos.overview: Micro accompanies Ruriko to choose a wedding gift for her friend. There she meets her aunt and uncle, who recognize her and want to take her home with them.

videos.title: An Oath for Victory
videos.overview: Ken will fight his first tag team match alongside Tiger Man. The young man is going through a happy period, but Mr. X returns to haunt him.

videos.title: The Hunter of Death
videos.overview: Mister X is increasingly determined to eliminate Tiger Man in order to save his own life. For this reason, he decides to no longer limit himself in choosing fighters.

videos.title: Jekyll and Hyde
videos.overview: Tiger invites the children and Ruriko to his next match. His opponent this time is very unusual, as he has a split personality.

videos.title: The Tiger Hunting Plan
videos.overview: Mister X is becoming increasingly agitated due to his continuous failures. Meanwhile, Naoto has to worry about little Gaboten, who has been taken away by the police.

videos.title: Scaffold with Fire
videos.overview: Mister X, now at his limit, wants to eliminate Tiger before the leader of Tiger's Den arrives in Japan, to avoid his wrath.

videos.title: Happiness of Yoshi-bo
videos.overview: Naoto takes a day off and decides to spend it at Ruriko's orphanage. There, he discovers that a family wants to adopt little Yoshibo.

videos.title: The Uncrowned Champ
videos.overview: Mister X travels to America in search of new talent to recruit and unleash against Tiger Man. He eventually finds someone interested in his offer.

videos.title: Devilish Spider Nest
videos.overview: The leader of Tiger's Den arrives in Japan and contemplates returning to the ring to face Tiger Man. Meanwhile, he has brought a new opponent with him.

videos.title: Suspicion of the Mysterious Man
videos.overview: The leader of Tiger's Den decides to join the Japanese Federation. Here he takes on the identity of Mistero Nero and asks to face only foreign wrestlers.

videos.title: For Today's Life
videos.overview: Mistero Nero proves increasingly difficult to defeat and continues to beat his opponents with extreme ease.

videos.title: The Substitute of Tiger
videos.overview: Naoto's next opponents have been announced, but Mistero Nero is still not among them. What could the leader of Tana delle Tigri have in mind?

videos.title: The Piranhan
videos.overview: Tiger Man will fight for the first time in a ring completely surrounded by water. His opponent is the fearsome Piranha.

videos.title: Who Is Tiger Mask?
videos.overview: Kenta wants to discover Tiger Man's identity at all costs and believes he can find out from Ken. For this reason, he tries to trap him.

videos.title: Presentiment of Defeat
videos.overview: Technique, speed, and strength. Mistero Nero seems to have no weaknesses and continues to defeat opponents with great ease.

videos.title: The Desperate Tiger
videos.overview: Tiger Man is increasingly troubled by thoughts of Mistero Nero. Meanwhile, Kenta gets involved in a fight with three young bullies.

videos.title: Howl for Blood, Wolf!
videos.overview: Tana delle Tigri sends another fighter to battle Tiger Man: Lupo Solitario. For Mistero Nero, this is another opportunity to study Naoto's techniques.

videos.title: Create Your Own Tomorrow
videos.overview: A man arrives at the orphanage claiming to be Yoshibo's father, but he does not reveal himself to the child. The next morning, his younger brother also shows up.

videos.title: The Execution of Tiger's Cave
videos.overview: Mistero Nero challenges Ken to a fight. Naoto is very worried about his friend, who accepts the challenge without hesitation.

videos.title: The Truth of Tiger's Cave
videos.overview: Ken is in terrible condition and also needs blood transfusions. Naoto swears revenge against the evil Great Tiger.

videos.title: The Struggle Tiger's Cave
videos.overview: Ruriko has finally discovered Tiger Man's secret. However, she is distraught because she fears that Naoto will be killed by Big Tiger.

videos.title: The Bloody Battle with Tiger's Cave!
videos.overview: Naoto learns of Mister X's death from the newspaper. Now, Big Tiger is the last remaining member of Tiger's Den, as well as her upcoming opponent.

videos.title: Tiger Mask Goes Away
videos.overview: The match between Tiger Man and Great Tiger is extremely violent. The evil wrestler uses every means possible to defeat his opponent. Will Naoto manage to win again this time?

videos.title: Howl! The Oath of the Ring
videos.overview: Suddenly, a masked wrestler and space mask science fiction that forces Antonio Inoki to challenge appeared. He was an assassin sent by the mysterious organization, the Space Pro-Wrestling Federation. Space mask science fiction that bursts into the ring and challenges Inoki. There, a man with a tiger mask appeared like a gale. He calls himself Tiger Mask II, the successor of Naoto Date's will!

videos.title: The Man Who Was Forged in the Hole of the Tiger
videos.overview: The Space Pro-Wrestling Federation begins to explore the identity of Tiger Mask. The defeated space mask science fiction approaches Inoki to rematch Tiger. But Inoki didn't know the whereabouts of Tiger... At that time, Tiger appears in front of Inoki and begins to talk about his true identity. There is also a huge evil shadow approaching in the Japanese professional wrestling world...

videos.title: The Battle to Death in Masks
videos.overview: Space mask SF that lost the first game and burned with revenge. A one-game game between him and Tiger Mask was about to begin. In this game, each other's masks are supposed to be bet. As soon as the gong rings, the exchange of advanced techniques begins. The tiger that is gradually being driven into inferiority explodes with the special move of the space mask!

videos.title: Tora, Inhaler of Blood
videos.overview: A terrible conspiracy was revealed by Space Mask SF. The Space Professional Wrestling Federation was trying to take over the Japanese professional wrestling world. Moreover, the Space Professional Wrestling Federation will immediately send in a second assassin. It's The Bat, which is good at simitling attacks. Bat defeats the popular villain wrestler Bigwood and forces Tiger to confront him!

videos.title: Youth Hunting
videos.overview: Tatsuo begins to investigate the disappearance of some high school students, all of them emerged in various sports.

videos.title: The Burning Fight Spirit
videos.overview: Tiger Mask II and the police rescue the boys from the ship.

videos.title: Puzzle of Tiger Perimeter
videos.overview: Tiger Mask II takes Inoki by car to the foot of Mount Fuji by showing him, through the crack of the trunk of a tree, a pyramid, which for years has remained hidden by vegetation.

videos.title: Decisive Battle! Tag Match
videos.overview: Mister Who N ° 1 and N ° 2 have just arrived by plane in Japan, while Midori informs Tatsuo that the true identity of Kyuketsu-Kamen The Bat has been discovered.

videos.title: Dangerous! Japanese Pro Wrestling
videos.overview: The match against Mister Who N ° 1 and N ° 2 is becoming a massacre, in fact they are dominating the match by attacking their opponents in two against one as Inoki and Tiger Mask II persist in fighting loyally.

videos.title: The Challenge of Iron Mask
videos.overview: At the airport Tatsuo meets Rita, a friend and American journalist.

videos.title: The Cold-Hearted Rule
videos.overview: Tiger mask faces iron mask but he notes that there is something familiar in the Iron Mask technique, equal to that of Rita.

videos.title: The Hawk of Hell
videos.overview: The mysterious head of the Space Wrestling Federation decides to go personally to Japan to attend the tag match where their new masked wrestlers.

videos.title: The Thousand Knocks of Shigeo Nagashima
videos.overview: Tatsuo learns that Emir Arman Hassan, with whom Japan has entered into an agreement for the sale and purchase of oil, will come to Yokohama aboard his luxury ship.

videos.title: Immortal Champion Belt
videos.overview: Tatsuo is working out the counter-move with which to beat the Hawk of Hell

videos.title: A Space Professional Wrestling Union!?
videos.overview: The day of the match against the Hell Hawks has arrived, Hassan also attends the match sitting in a front row seat.

videos.title: Tatsuo Aku Approaches Hassan
videos.overview: Nobody welcomes the fact that Inoki and Tiger Mask II do not want to sell New Japan Pro-Wrestling to Hassan despite the fact that he threatens to no longer distribute oil to Japan.

videos.title: Recollection: Pro Wrestling's Way
videos.overview: Tiger Mask, attacked by Hassan's rugby team, remembers his youth in the United States, studied in New York and worked for a newsroom.

videos.title: Trap! One Second Before Gong
videos.overview: A helicopter lands on the Oil King, the passenger is Seido Muscle, a huge savage who will be the partner of Shinigami Silver in the upcoming tag match against Inoki and Tiger Mask II.

videos.title: Death God Silver's Betrayal
videos.overview: The tag match begins and Tiger Mask II faces Shinigami Silver whose build has claws and sharp horns with which it puts the opponent in difficulty.

videos.title: Crash! Tiger Hurricane
videos.overview: Shinigami Silver and Tiger Mask II face off in a great match but are then interrupted by Geller and his hit men.

videos.title: Hassan's Secret
videos.overview: Tiger Mask II trains with Inoki asking him to fight alone against Seido Muscle.

videos.title: Push Down Bronze Muscle!
videos.overview: The match begins but Seido Muscle does not suffer the attacks of Tiger Mask II thanks to his muscles.

videos.title: Butcher's Condition of Challenge
videos.overview: Abdullah the Butcher, a strong and famous Canadian wrestler, wants to challenge Tiger Mask II in a match.

videos.title: Tiger VS Butcher
videos.overview: Butcher gives Midori a private interview and reveals his past, the humiliations and sufferings he has suffered but which he has overcome, in addition to the motivations that led him to challenge Tiger Mask II in a match to the death.

videos.title: Men's Battle
videos.overview: Butcher puts Tiger Mask II in difficulty with his fast karate techniques, despite the masked wrestler defends himself very well, but Butcher starts fighting not respecting the rules.

videos.title: The Anger of Shun Hansen
videos.overview: American wrestlers not finding it right that the Space Wrestling Federation only fights against New Japan Pro-Wrestling decide to come forward, in fact one of them, Stan Hansen, challenges Devil Puma.

videos.title: The Gun Which Calls the Storm
videos.overview: The night of the match between Tiger Mask II and Devil Puma has arrived.

videos.title: Devil Chop of Fear
videos.overview: Tiger Mask II and Devil Puma face off in a match with no time limit, in a clash where both demonstrate that they have practically the same strength.

videos.title: Fly! Tatsuo Aku
videos.overview: Tatsuo brings Giena to Hakone and then two helicopters arrive, which suspects Tatsuo in fact those are the hit men of the Space Wrestling Federation. Geller, accompanied by Devil Puma, tries to kill Giena.

videos.title: Shivering Battle Royale
videos.overview: Tiger Mask II continues to fight against Devil Puma, who puts him in serious trouble with his deadly karate moves.

videos.title: Hassan's Fire Blowing Anger
videos.overview: Tiger Mask II reaches the ring for Battle Royale, then riding a horse comes Hakuma Knight, the second strongest wrestler in the Space Wrestling Federation.

videos.title: The Gong's High Ringing Decisive Battle
videos.overview: Hassan proposes that the strongest wrestler in the Space Wrestling Federation fight against André The Giant.

videos.title: The Unwanted Result at the Battle's Conclusion
videos.overview: Tiger Mask II and The Strongs continue to fight in an exceptional match.
